svg.title: Return — Noctilucent Vector
svg.desc: Zero-margin HyperWeave RETURN button. Swept cryogenic vector arrow flush-aligned to markdown prose column.

hw:chromatic.phenomenology: Zero-padding cryogenic action plate; swept electric arrow aligned flush with typography

hw:zone.reason: Discrete quantized LUT reproducing cryogenic liquid isotherms
Swept return vector rendered in directional arctic gradient

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Crop the artifact viewport to the exact outer perimeter (236x56) to eliminate dead whitespace that was breaking Markdown typography flow and causing indentation offset.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: All internal coordinates are normalized by (-12px, -12px). The outer bezel is anchored at (0.5, 0.5) with width 235 and height 55, ensuring stroke boundaries touch the canvas margin with zero lateral or vertical offset. Text and arrow are re-centered symmetrically within the 224px surface plate.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Tight canvas crop leaves 0px overflow buffer for external drop shadows; glow and caustics are strictly contained within the perimeter moat.
hw:reasoning.hw:constraints-applied: zero-js, zero-padding, markdown-flush, adaptive-theme, phi-timing, smil-filter-currents, wcag-aa-gated
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Canvas 236x56; outer frame at x0.5 y0.5 w235 h55 rx15.5; surface plate at x6 y6 w224 h44 rx10; hairline at x9 y9 w218 h38 rx7; word anchor x93 y34; arrow origin x149 y40; arrow tip x173 y12.
